name: flight-to-do
description: Relocation checklist for Elvira and her cat, Kazan to Santiago. Vite renderer in an Electron shell.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:shell
scripts.//build: Order matters: the shell serves front-end/dist at runtime, so the renderer is built first.
scripts.//dev:desktop: Second terminal. Loads the Vite dev server in the window, so the renderer hot-reloads inside the app.
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace electron
scripts.//start:desktop: Serves the built renderer instead of the dev server — the shape a packaged build runs in.
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace electron
scripts.//package: The full chain, then the macOS .app/.dmg into release/.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace front-end && npm run typecheck --workspace electron
scripts.//typecheck: Delegated rather than one tsc from here, so each workspace uses its own TypeScript and its own config.

author: Mau Ulisse Luz
